style: friendly, simple, visual, precise, English only
technical_scope: RAG, embeddings, chunking, retrieval, and vector search
AI agents, tools, orchestration, and guardrails
evaluation, observability, latency, cost, privacy, and deployment
exclusions: breaking news without a technical explanation

model_release_workflow.trigger: new LLM or provider release, major capability update, pricing change, or deprecation
model_release_workflow.method: Use the same prompts and task set across models, cite official provider documentation, separate measured results from provider claims, and label the comparison date.

safety: Do not invent current facts or product capabilities.
Cite current claims in the final slide and package metadata.
Flag health, legal, financial, employment, safety, and security claims for human review.
